Name: Custom Expanded Greenhouse
Author: Snorlie
Description:
[size=4]*My first mod, I tested with a few farm layouts, but cannot guarantee I did everything right. PLEASE BACK UP YOUR GAME FILES.*[/size]

I wanted a specific layout for the greenhouse so I made it. The other mods on Nexus are fantastic, but I didn't want something crazy. I just wanted a neat space for the 19 saplings across SV, SVE, and RSV. This replaces the vanilla greenhouse so please back up your game files before using, especially if you've already planted anything in your greenhouse. I started learning how to make maps and finished this in about 6 hours, as far as I can tell everything works. All planting spots work and trees grow, the water trough refills your watering can, just the basics. I wasn't planning to post it, but figured if I went through the trouble of making it work, someone else may like the layout.

[size=4][u][b]Requirements:
[/b][/u][/size]SMAPI
Content Patcher

[size=4][b][u]Compatibility:
[/u][/b][/size]This replaces the vanilla greenhouse interior, so as long as another mod doesn't touch that map file it should be fine.

[size=4][b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b][/size]Extract file and put into your mods folder

If you have any issues, please leave a comment and I'll see what I can do. I hate to keep repeating myself, but first time doing any kind of modding so no promises. If nothing else, at least others will know about any issues. Also, I don't mind if anyone wants to make suggestions, but I did make this custom tailored to my specific wants, I'd love to hear your ideas even if I won't/can't implement them.

Downloads.Description: Main File. I set the wrong version in the content.json, now it shouldn't show up on SMAPI log as not updated for 1.6. And now I've fixed it so the manifest has the right version and won't say it needs an update.
